title: Stunting, Small island developing states (SIDS), by location
headline: In 20 of 25 SIDS, stunting was higher in rural than in urban areas in the latest survey
subtitle: Percentage of under-fives falling below minus 2 standard deviations (moderate and severe) from the median height-for-age of the reference population
years: Latest surveys with both groups, 2010 to 2022; median gap 2.5 points.
data_line: Data: UNICEF Data Warehouse via UN System Data Commons, indicator NT_ANT_HAZ_NE2, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: In 20 of 25 SIDS, stunting was higher in rural than in urban areas in the latest survey. Latest surveys with both groups, 2010 to 2022; median gap 2.5 points. Gap between rural areas and urban areas in 25 countries, ranked; 20 with rural areas higher, 5 with urban areas higher.
method: Method: gap within each country's latest survey with both groups.
question: Where have you seen the gap in stunting between rural areas and urban areas close, and how was it measured?
